name: Vell Sain
source: Veil is the daughter of Tria and the previous Maou of the demon world.  She is also considered to be one of the single most powerful individuals in existence based on sheer magical power.  [spoiler] Veil is completely and utterly devoted to Hime, having been saved by him after she tried to kill him and was betrayed, losing half her eight wings to the traitor.  She calls herself 'Hime's magic' and her standards for what matters in life are completely based around what makes Hime happy and how to get Hime to love her.  She will gladly obliterate anyone who harms or threatens to harm Hime, with a truly demonic degree of ruthlessness.[/spoiler]
